_meta.title: OECD Social Institutions and Gender Index (SIGI) - all editions
_meta.measures: Discrimination against women in social institutions (laws, attitudes, practices). Higher = more discrimination.
_meta.source: OECD Development Centre, SIGI / Gender, Institutions and Development Database (GID-DB)
_meta.licence: CC BY 4.0 (OECD open-access policy since July 2024; OECD terms page https://www.oecd.org/en/about/terms-conditions.html could not be fetched here - Cloudflare challenge)
_meta.citation: OECD (2023), SIGI 2023 Global Report: Gender Equality in Times of Crisis, OECD Publishing, Paris; data: OECD Data Explorer, Social Institutions and Gender Index (SIGI) 2023 (and archived 2019, 2014, 2012, 2009 editions).
notes: Editions are not comparable: 2023/2019 use a 0-100 scale and 4 sub-indices; 2014/2012 use 0-1 and 5 sub-indices (incl. son bias); 2009 uses 0-1 with different sub-index names.

category_from_oecd_bands is computed by this script from the OECD published bands (<=20 very low, 20-30 low, 30-40 medium, 40-50 high, >50 very high) for 2023 and 2019 only; OECD does not publish a category column in the SDMX data. Values exactly on a boundary are put in the lower band (genderindex.org/2019-categories uses <=).

null = OECD lists the country but publishes no value (insufficient data). Top-level value/year = latest edition; when that is null, latest_edition_with_overall_score names an older edition (not substituted).
Aggregates (World, regions, OECD, EU, G7, G20) are in _aggregates, not in the country list.

Codes as published by OECD: XKV and XKO both = Kosovo (in different editions); SCG = Serbia and Montenegro (2009); TWN = Chinese Taipei; PSE = Palestinian Authority or West Bank and Gaza Strip; HKG = Hong Kong, China; PRI = Puerto Rico.

PSE.name: Palestinian Authority or West Bank and Gaza Strip
